This patch removes the entwining of cpusets and hotplug code in the ""No
more Mr.  Nice Guy"" case of sched.c move_task_off_dead_cpu().
Since the hotplug code is holding a spinlock at this point
the cpuset semaphore
column3: as would seem to be required either to

column1: update the tasks cpuset
column2: or to scan up the nested cpuset chain

column1: the nearest cpuset ancestor that still has some CPUs that are online.  So
we just punt and blast the tasks cpus_allowed with all bits allowed.
This reverts these lines of code to what they were before the cpuset patch.
And it updates the cpuset Doc file
The one known alternative to this that seems to work came from Dinakar
Guniguntala
column2: and required the hotplug code to take the cpuset_sem semaphore

column1: much earlier in its processing.  So far as we know
entanglement between cpusets and hot plug of this alternative approach is
not worth doing in this case.
